name: Remove Duplicate Lines
summary: Deduplicate text lines in your browser — keep first or last, ignore case, trim, or preserve blanks.
description: Paste any multi-line text and remove duplicate lines while preserving order. Options include case-insensitive matching, trim-before-compare, keep all blank lines, and keep the last occurrence instead of the first. Processing stays local.

faqs.question: Does order matter?
faqs.answer: Yes. By default the first occurrence of each line is kept and later duplicates are dropped. Enable “Keep last occurrence” to reverse that.

faqs.question: What about blank lines?
faqs.answer: Blank lines are treated like any other line unless you enable “Keep blank lines”, which preserves every empty line.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Deduplication runs entirely in your browser.
